sourceTitle: L-Threonine production from acetate by metabolically engineered Corynebacterium glutamicum using a pH-controlled fed-batch process.
sourceAbstract: Acetate has a considerable potential as a non-food feedstock for microbial bioproduction, yet its use for amino acid production remains underexplored. Here, we developed a process for L-threonine production from acetate as the sole carbon source with Corynebacterium glutamicum by integrating rational, genome-based metabolic engineering with pH-coupled fed-batch cultivation. The engineered strain AT-3 carried five chromosomal mutations that alleviated feedback inhibition of key enzymes and redirected carbon flux toward the aspartate pathway. Substrate supply was controlled using a custom Visual Basic-based feeding script that automatically adjusted the acetic acid feed in response to online pH measurements. Robust process performance was maintained during a tenfold scale-up from 100-mL DASbox to 1-L DASGIP bioreactors. The optimized process achieved an L-threonine titer of 10.04 g/L and a yield of 0.086 g/g acetate. This study provides a basis for further studies on the development and improvement of acetate-based amino acid production process. KEY POINTS: • Plasmid-free C. glutamicum strains produce L-threonine in acetate minimal medium • pH-controlled acetic acid feed in bioreactors improved L-threonine production • Acetate-based production of feed amino acids avoids competition with human food.
titleZh: 采用pH控制的补料分批工艺，利用代谢工程改造的谷氨酸棒杆菌以乙酸盐生产L-苏氨酸
abstractZh: 乙酸盐作为微生物生物生产的非粮原料具有很大潜力，但其在氨基酸生产中的应用仍缺乏充分探索。本研究将基于基因组的理性代谢工程与pH耦合的补料分批培养相结合，开发了利用谷氨酸棒杆菌、以乙酸盐为唯一碳源生产L-苏氨酸的工艺。工程菌株AT-3携带5处染色体突变，缓解了关键酶的反馈抑制，并将碳通量引向天冬氨酸途径。研究者利用以Visual Basic编写的定制补料脚本控制底物供应，根据在线pH测量结果自动调整乙酸补料。从100 mL DASbox生物反应器放大至1 L DASGIP生物反应器、规模扩大10倍后，工艺仍保持稳定表现。优化后的工艺实现了10.04 g/L的L-苏氨酸滴度，得率为0.086 g/g乙酸盐。本研究为进一步开发和改进以乙酸盐为原料的氨基酸生产工艺提供了基础。要点：①无质粒的谷氨酸棒杆菌菌株可在乙酸盐最小培养基中生产L-苏氨酸；②在生物反应器中通过pH控制乙酸补料，提高了L-苏氨酸产量；③以乙酸盐生产饲用氨基酸可避免与人类食物竞争原料。

sourceTitle: Biomimetic Nanosystems as Emerging Catalysts for Translational Innovation in Healthcare.
sourceAbstract: Biomimetic nanosystems are engineered platforms at the nanoscale range that emulate selected structural and compositional features to reproduce their advantageous interactions with the complex biological environments. These systems, inspired by the biological cell membrane(s), have emerged as a promising technology with a variety of biomedical applications. However, they are still in their early stage of clinical development. Biomimetic nanosystems may be produced by incorporating the desired nanoparticles into synthesized membrane(s). Such nanosystems exhibit greater immunocompatibility, immune evasion, and extended circulation times. Therefore, this study examines the latest advancements in the design and engineering of biomimetic nanosystems, focusing on membrane insertion/integration, hybridization, surface functionalization and modification, and metabolic engineering that could enhance the multifunctionality, hybrid membrane engineering, stimulus-responsive behavior, and scalability of these systems. The unique characteristics of these nanosystems have been investigated and applied in various fields, including medicine delivery, vaccine research, antidote(s) manufacturing, imaging, and sensing, which are critically discussed. Furthermore, this review has summarized the practical challenges related to translation, such as stability, reproducibility, functionality, regulatory complexity, and efficacy. This review also highlights both the opportunities and limitations of these emerging platforms and outlines key directions for the development of clinically relevant nanomedicine. As a result, this study serves as the foundation for future research into the multifunctional nanobiomimetic system.
titleZh: 仿生纳米系统：推动医疗健康转化创新的新兴力量
abstractZh: 仿生纳米系统是纳米尺度的工程化平台，通过模拟特定的结构和组成特征，重现其与复杂生物环境之间的有利相互作用。这些受生物细胞膜启发的系统已成为一种具有多种生物医学应用前景的技术，但仍处于临床开发的早期阶段。仿生纳米系统可通过将所需的纳米颗粒整合入合成膜而制备。这类系统表现出更高的免疫相容性、更强的免疫逃逸能力以及更长的循环时间。因此，本研究考察了仿生纳米系统设计与工程化的最新进展，重点关注膜插入与整合、杂合化、表面功能化与修饰，以及代谢工程；这些策略有望增强系统的多功能性，改进杂合膜工程，并提高刺激响应性和可规模化能力。这些纳米系统的独特特征已在药物递送、疫苗研究、解毒剂制造、成像和传感等多个领域得到研究与应用，本文对这些应用进行了批判性讨论。此外，本综述总结了转化过程中面临的实际挑战，包括稳定性、可重复性、功能性、监管复杂性和有效性。综述还强调了这些新兴平台的机遇与局限，并概述了开发具有临床应用意义的纳米药物的关键方向。因此，本研究为未来开展多功能纳米仿生系统研究提供了基础。

sourceTitle: Spatial control of enzyme orientation at the lipid droplet interface enables regio- and chemoselective metabolic flux.
sourceAbstract: Precise spatial control over multienzyme cascade reactions is increasingly recognized as a design lever in synthetic biology for enhancing catalytic performance and directing metabolic flux. By emulating principles of cellular compartmentalization, synthetic scaffolds and engineered interfaces have emerged as powerful platforms to modulate intermediate channeling and reaction efficiency in complex biocatalytic systems. However, robust and spatially defined immobilization of multienzyme assemblies within physicochemically optimal compartments remains challenging because of the dynamic intracellular environment. Here, we reprogram the amphiphilic interface of yeast lipid droplets (LDs) as a programmable scaffold system to support regio- and chemoselective localization of enzymes. Guided by molecular dynamics simulations, we designed LD-anchoring motifs to direct the enzyme orientation at the LD monolayer interface, yielding cytosol-facing or LD inner-facing configurations. Using this designed LD-anchoring motif, we spatially reorganize a trienzyme cascade for prodeoxyviolacein (PDV) biosynthesis across the cytosol-LD interface, facilitating directional conversion of hydrophilic substrates into hydrophobic products. This spatial reorganization substantially improved PDV production by 1300%, achieving 46.25 milligrams per liter. Our approach offers a modular and tunable platform for engineering spatially organized and readily deployable enzyme cascades, opening avenues for biosynthetic catalysis at organellar interfaces.
titleZh: 在脂滴界面空间调控酶取向，实现具有区域选择性和化学选择性的代谢通量
abstractZh: 对多酶级联反应进行精确的空间调控，正日益被视为合成生物学中提高催化性能和引导代谢通量的一种设计手段。通过模拟细胞区室化原理，合成支架与工程化界面已成为在复杂生物催化体系中调节中间体通道化和反应效率的有力平台。然而，由于细胞内环境具有动态性，要在理化条件最优的区室内稳固且以明确的空间位置固定多酶组装体，仍然具有挑战性。本研究将酵母脂滴（LDs）的两亲性界面改造为可编程支架体系，以支持酶具有区域选择性和化学选择性的定位。在分子动力学模拟的指导下，研究者设计了脂滴锚定基序，以控制酶在脂滴单分子层界面的取向，形成朝向细胞质溶胶或脂滴内部的构型。利用这一设计的脂滴锚定基序，研究者在细胞质溶胶与脂滴的界面两侧，对用于prodeoxyviolacein（PDV）生物合成的三酶级联进行了空间重组，促进亲水底物向疏水产物的定向转化。这种空间重组使PDV产量显著提高了1300%，达到46.25 mg/L。该方法为构建具有空间组织且便于应用的酶级联提供了模块化、可调节的平台，为在细胞器界面开展生物合成催化开辟了方向。
